quote: The expert in anything was once a beginner.
author: Helen Hayes
tip: Focus on understanding core fundamentals like the Box Model and JavaScript execution before moving to complex libraries.

quote: First, solve the problem. Then, write the code.
author: John Johnson
tip: Break down large React components into smaller, reusable UI pieces.

quote: Simplicity is the soul of efficiency.
author: Austin Freeman
tip: Always keep your state minimal and derive values using useMemo or standard JavaScript methods.

quote: Code is like humor. When you have to explain it, it is bad.
author: Cory House
tip: Write self-describing variable names and keep function responsibilities single and clear.

quote: Continuous learning is the minimum requirement for success in any field.
author: Brian Tracy
tip: Practice building small projects regularly to reinforce your React hooks knowledge.
